comment: Independent detect.c find_trap() cluttered-square arm for a rider. A debug-mode Knight mounts the adjacent south pony (forced), wishes for an arrow trap underfoot (maketrap() leaves it unseen), drops the lance on it, steps west and searches. The remembered lance hides the trap, so find_trap() clears the map and draws the trap and display_self(), which shows the ridden pony rather than the hero.
